The decisive mistake was the MovieProp_Expert's claim at step 2 that the parachute was simply white. The film's answer is orange and white, so this was an incomplete color answer stated without checking, and every later step built on it. FilmCritic_Expert's step 4 also failed, since it claimed to have cross-referenced sources without showing any evidence and confirmed "white," but it was verifying the wrong claim in the first place. The error originated with the MovieProp_Expert.
